decks.notes: The main focus of this deck is to quickly deal damage to the opponent using cheap burn spells and efficient creatures. By utilizing cards like Thermo-Alchemist and Voldaren Epicure to deal consistent damage, paired with a suite of direct damage spells like Chain Lightning, Lava Spike, and Lightning Bolt, the deck aims to chip away at the opponent's life total while controlling the board with cards like Searing Blaze. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with burn damage and finish them off with a big Fireblast.

The main theme of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with low-cost, evasive creatures and disruptive spells. By combining efficient threats like Delver of Secrets and Ninja of the Deep Hours with countermagic like Counterspell and Force Spike, the deck aims to pressure the opponent while protecting its own creatures. The inclusion of card draw and manipulation spells like Ponder and Preordain ensures the deck can consistently find its key cards and maintain a steady stream of threats. Overall, the Mono Blue Aggro deck is focused on tempo and aggression, aiming to quickly close out the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck focuses on playing artifacts quickly to overwhelm the opponent with early aggression and synergy. By using cards like Atog and Myr Enforcer, along with support from Disciple of the Vault and Galvanic Blast, the goal is to deal damage efficiently and quickly. Thoughtcast helps to draw more cards and maintain momentum, while cards like Blood Fountain and Makeshift Munitions provide additional avenues for dealing damage. The deck utilizes a mix of sacrifice effects and burn spells, along with card draw and mana fixing, to create a fast-paced and versatile strategy.

The deck focuses on quickly building a board presence and overwhelming the opponent with efficient and aggressive creatures such as Atog, Myr Enforcer, and Disciple of the Vault. It also utilizes artifact synergies and card draw effects like Thoughtcast to maintain card advantage. The inclusion of Galvanic Blast and Fling provides reach and burn capabilities to close out games. With a mix of sacrifice outlets and artifacts, the deck aims to utilize the artifact affinity mechanic to its fullest potential and outpace the opponent in a fast-paced, aggressive playstyle.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying artifacts and sacrificing them to generate value and deal damage to the opponent. By utilizing cards like Atog, Disciple of the Vault, and Myr Enforcer, the deck can apply early pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan. With cards like Thoughtcast and Galvanic Blast, the deck can draw cards and efficiently remove threats. The inclusion of cards like Deadly Dispute, Fling, and Makeshift Munitions allows the deck to further capitalize on sacrificing artifacts for maximum impact. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a fast and aggressive strategy centered around sacrificing artifacts.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying artifacts to the battlefield, leveraging cards like Atog, Disciple of the Vault, and Myr Enforcer to overwhelm the opponent with efficient threats. By combining artifact synergy with card draw spells like Thoughtcast and efficient removal like Galvanic Blast, the deck aims to close out the game quickly while maintaining card advantage. Additionally, sacrificing artifacts for value with cards like Deadly Dispute and Fling can provide the final push needed to secure victory. The deck's mana base includes a mix of artifact lands and color fixing to ensure consistent resource development.

The main idea of this Pauper UR Control deck is to disrupt and control the opponent's game plan by using counterspells, removal spells, and card draw. The deck aims to control the board with creatures like Augur of Bolas and Spellstutter Sprite, while also using spells like Lightning Bolt and Skred to deal with threats. The deck also utilizes card selection with Preordain and Brainstorm to find key pieces and maintain card advantage. By efficiently controlling the game and drawing into win conditions, this deck aims to outlast and outplay the opponent.

The main concept of the deck is to control the game by utilizing creatures with powerful abilities like Archaeomancer and Mulldrifter, while also having access to efficient card draw and selection spells like Ponder and Preordain. The deck aims to outvalue the opponent by consistently recurring cards with Ephemerate and Ghostly Flicker, while disrupting their game plan with counterspells like Counterspell and Prohibit. The mana base is optimized for consistency and allows for easy access to all colors needed for the deck's spells. Overall, the deck seeks to establish a dominant board state and grind out a victory through attrition.

The main concept of this deck is to build a defensive wall of high-toughness creatures like Axebane Guardian and Overgrown Battlement while generating mana with cards like Arbor Elf and Utopia Sprawl. Once the wall is set up, the player can use combo pieces like Galvanic Alchemist and Freed from the Real to generate infinite mana and eventually win the game with Valakut Invoker or another win condition. The deck also includes card draw and recursion with Mulldrifter and Mnemonic Wall to ensure consistency in executing the combo.

The main idea behind this Pauper Aggro-Burn deck is to deal damage as quickly and efficiently as possible to the opponent. This is achieved through cheap and direct damage spells like Lightning Bolt, Lava Spike, and Fireblast, as well as creature damage from Thermo-Alchemist and Voldaren Epicure. The goal is to maintain constant pressure on the opponent, burning them out before they can stabilize or gain control of the game. The inclusion of cards like Searing Blaze and Curse of the Pierced Heart also helps to further this strategy.

The deck focuses on utilizing artifacts to quickly build a board presence and overwhelm opponents with aggressive creatures like Atog and Myr Enforcer. By sacrificing artifacts for various effects such as damage, card draw, and life gain, players can keep the pressure on while disrupting the opponent's game plan. With an emphasis on efficient damage dealing spells like Galvanic Blast and ways to sacrifice artifacts like Deadly Dispute and Fling, the deck aims to end the game quickly before the opponent can stabilize.

The deck focuses on quickly getting creatures on the board and maintaining control with counterspells. It utilizes evasive creatures like Delver of Secrets and Ninja of the Deep Hours to deal damage and draw cards. Faeries like Spellstutter Sprite provide additional disruption, while card draw spells like Ponder and Preordain help maintain card advantage. The deck also includes some pump spells like Mutagenic Growth for extra burst damage. The goal is to apply pressure early and disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining a steady stream of threats.

This deck focuses on quickly getting out artifact creatures and sacrificing them for value. By using cards like Deadly Dispute and Fling, the deck can deal direct damage or draw cards while benefiting from sacrificing artifacts. The key is to overwhelm the opponent with early aggression and utilize artifacts like Chromatic Star and Ichor Wellspring to generate additional value. With a mix of aggressive creatures and powerful artifacts, this deck aims to win by outpacing and outvaluing the opponent in a Pauper 1 vs 1 format.

This Boros Aggro deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a quick and efficient creature presence while also utilizing efficient removal spells to maintain board control. The deck focuses on utilizing cheap and efficient creatures like Seeker of the Way and Squadron Hawk, along with pump effects like Rally the Peasants to close out games quickly. Prismatic Strands also helps protect against opposing removal spells, making it difficult for opponents to break through the deck's defenses. The deck's overall strategy is to maintain aggression while also providing some resilience and flexibility through its removal and protection spells.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and aggressive playstyle. It focuses on efficient creatures like Seeker of the Way and Squadron Hawk to quickly deal damage, while also having access to removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Journey to Nowhere to clear the way. The deck includes card advantage engines like Faithless Looting and Battle Screech to maintain momentum. It also has ways to protect itself with Prismatic Strands and Mana Tithe, as well as ways to close out the game with Rally the Peasants.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble a board full of artifacts and use them to deal damage to the opponent. By playing efficient creatures like Atog and Myr Enforcer alongside cards like Disciple of the Vault and Galvanic Blast, the deck aims to take advantage of the synergy between artifacts and sacrifice effects. This strategy is supported by card draw spells like Thoughtcast and consistent mana sources like Prophetic Prism and Chromatic Star. Additionally, there are cards like Deadly Dispute and Fling to provide additional reach and ways to close out games.
